
import React from 'react'

/* @jsxRuntime classic */

import { TabNavigation, Flex, FlexItem, FlexJustify, Callout, Category, TextLink } from '@drawbotics/react-drylus';

const layoutProps = {
  
};
const MDXLayout = "wrapper"
export default function MDXContent({
  components,
  ...props
}) {
  return <MDXLayout {...layoutProps} {...props} components={components} mdxType="MDXLayout">


<h1>{`Tab Navigation`}</h1>
<Callout category={Category.DANGER} mdxType="Callout">
  This component has been deprecated, please use <Link href="/component-kit/components/tab-menu" mdxType="Link"><TextLink mdxType="TextLink">TabMenu</TextLink></Link> instead.
</Callout>
<p>{`It is primarily used to change the context of a whole page, that is in contrast with `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`SegmentedControl`}</inlineCode>{` which only should modify part of a page's content.`}</p>
<pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-jsx"
      }}>{`import { TabNavigation } from '@drawbotics/react-drylus';
`}</code></pre>
<p><strong parentName="p">{`Example`}</strong></p>
<p>{`This is the most basic usage of a tab navigation:`}</p>
<Playground __position={1} __code={`<ControlledField component={
  <TabNavigation
    options={[{
      label: 'First choice',
      value: 'first',
    }, {
      label: 'Second choice',
      value: 'second',
    }, {
      label: 'Third',
      value: 'third',
      bullet: 4,
      disabled: true,
    }]} />
} />`} component={TabNavigation} mdxType="Playground">
  <ControlledField component={<TabNavigation options={[{
        label: 'First choice',
        value: 'first'
      }, {
        label: 'Second choice',
        value: 'second'
      }, {
        label: 'Third',
        value: 'third',
        bullet: 4,
        disabled: true
      }]} mdxType="TabNavigation" />} mdxType="ControlledField" />
</Playground>
<p>{`However it can also be set vertically, and each value may have bullets (similarly to `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`SegmentedControl`}</inlineCode>{`), and may also be disabled.`}</p>
<Playground __position={2} __code={`<div style={{ maxWidth: 300 }}>
  <ControlledField component={
    <TabNavigation
      vertical
      options={[{
        label: 'First choice',
        value: 'first',
        bullet: 4,
      }, {
        label: 'Second choice',
        value: 'second',
        bullet: 10,
        disabled: true,
      }, {
        label: 'Third',
        value: 'third',
        bullet: 123,
      }, {
        label: 'Fourth',
        value: 'fourth',
        bullet: 40,
      }]} />
    } />
</div>`} mdxType="Playground">
  <div style={{
        maxWidth: 300
      }}>
    <ControlledField component={<TabNavigation vertical options={[{
          label: 'First choice',
          value: 'first',
          bullet: 4
        }, {
          label: 'Second choice',
          value: 'second',
          bullet: 10,
          disabled: true
        }, {
          label: 'Third',
          value: 'third',
          bullet: 123
        }, {
          label: 'Fourth',
          value: 'fourth',
          bullet: 40
        }]} mdxType="TabNavigation" />} mdxType="ControlledField" />
  </div>
</Playground>
<p>{`Each option can also be given a `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`loading`}</inlineCode>{` value (useful when loading the data to determine the bullet number):`}</p>
<Playground __position={3} __code={`<Flex justify={FlexJustify.SPACE_AROUND}>
  <FlexItem>
    <div style={{ maxWidth: 300 }}>
      <ControlledField component={

  </FlexItem>
  <FlexItem>

        options={[{

        }, {

          value: 'second',
          loading: true,
          disabled: true,
        }]} />
    } />
  </FlexItem>
</Flex>`} mdxType="Playground">
  <Flex justify={FlexJustify.SPACE_AROUND} mdxType="Flex">
    <FlexItem mdxType="FlexItem">
      <div style={{
            maxWidth: 300
          }}>
        <ControlledField component={<TabNavigation vertical options={[{
              label: 'First choice',
              value: 'first',

      </div>
    </FlexItem>
    <FlexItem mdxType="FlexItem">
      <ControlledField component={<TabNavigation options={[{

            loading: true,
            disabled: true
          }]} mdxType="TabNavigation" />} mdxType="ControlledField" />

</Playground>
