<h1>{`Route change animation`}</h1>
<p>{`We used the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`element`}</inlineCode>{` prop from `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`react-router-dom`}</inlineCode>{`'s `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`Route`}</inlineCode>{` component, but only for illustrative purposes, this will work with any other way you structure your routes. You have to respect the following constraint however:`}</p>
<ul>
<li parentName="ul">
<p parentName="li">{`When having items come in and out (replacing the current content) then the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AnimationGroup`}</inlineCode>{` will automatically set the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`exitBeforeExit`}</inlineCode>{` prop from Framer, which will `}<em parentName="p">{`wait`}</em>{` for the previously visible elements to disappear. This prop `}<strong parentName="p">{`cannot work`}</strong>{` if there are more than 1 direct child of `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AnimationGroup`}</inlineCode>{`, this is a constraint from Framer`}</p>
</li>
<li parentName="ul">
<p parentName="li">{`The way Framer recognises unmounting, the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`key`}</inlineCode>{` given to the direct child has to change when you want the animation to be triggered. This is why in the example below the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`Routes`}</inlineCode>{` has a `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`key`}</inlineCode>{` equal to the current browser `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`location`}</inlineCode>{`. This patter can be applied to any child (e.g. in a gallery, each `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`img`}</inlineCode>{` will have a `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`key`}</inlineCode>{` equal to the currently active one, allowing the unmount animation to be triggered).`}</p>
</li>
<li parentName="ul">
<p parentName="li">{`As mentioned in the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AnimationGroup`}</inlineCode>{` doc, when setting `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`animateExit`}</inlineCode>{`, the prop will only propagate to the direct `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AnimatedItem`}</inlineCode>{`s, so any `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`AnimatedItem`}</inlineCode>{` you want to animate when unmounting will need to have the `}<inlineCode parentName="p">{`animateExit`}</inlineCode>{` prop manually set, like in the example below.`}</p>
</li>
</ul>

`}</code></pre>
